Maya Singh: Heads-up — API ref and SDK snippets are inconsistent for embeddings response. Some examples show `data[*].embedding` (array) while a couple of snippets refer to `data[*].vector`. Users are opening issues.
Ibrahim Khan: Oof. Where did you find `vector`?
Maya Singh: Two quickstart snippets: snippets/js/embeds_quickstart.js and snippets/go/embeds_quickstart.go. The OpenAPI response schema is `data` -> array of objects with `embedding`.
Olivia Park: The SDK historically exposed `vector` in a helper object but we removed that last year. Docs must show the canonical `embedding` field. Suggest: update JS/Go snippets to use `item.embedding` and add a short note in API ref: "Field `vector` was previously returned by older SDK wrappers; canonical field is `embedding`."
ci-bot: Lint: openapi/embeddings.yml response.example.data[0] type mismatch (expected object with `embedding`, found object with `vector`) in PR branch.
Ibrahim Khan: I'll update the JS and Go snippets and adjust the OpenAPI example to ensure it uses `embedding`. Also add a tiny callout under Embeddings -> Response shape.
Maya Singh: While you're at it, please tweak the Python snippet's parsing example too; it currently does `resp.data[0]['vector']` in one spot.
Olivia Park: I'll submit a short changelog entry linking to the clarification and mention "no runtime behavior changed" so customers know it's docs-only.
ci-bot: CI queued after push.
docs-bot: Reminder: preview will fail until example shapes match OpenAPI schema.
Ibrahim Khan: Pushed fixes: openapi example, js/go/python snippets updated to reference `embedding`, added migration note. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1204/files
ci-bot: All checks passed. PR merged.
Maya Singh: Thanks — I'll scan support tickets tomorrow and add FAQ if we still see confusion.
